programme.desc: Live. From his family's courageous journey in search of a better future to becoming one of Europe's most respected midfielders, this is the story of Granit Xhaka. We chart his rise through the game, the highs and lows of a career that tested his resilience, and the turbulent relationship with Arsenal supporters that ultimately became one of football's greatest redemption stories. Now in love with the game again at Sunderland, Xhaka's story proves that perseverance can define a legacy as much as succes.

programme.desc: Live. From his early years in Ivory Coast to leaving Africa for Europe, Amad Diallo's journey has been one of talent, determination and sacrifice. We follow Amad's remarkable rise and the journey that has taken him from humble beginnings to the heights of Old Trafford.

programme.desc: Live. Adored by Liverpool fans around the world, Robbie Fowler is one of the Premier League's all-time greats. The local lad reflects on his remarkable journey, from his prolific breakthrough at Anfield, to an unprecedented cup treble and an emotional homecoming on Merseyside.

programme.title: THE CATCH-UP SHOW - EP6
programme.desc: Live. Relive the standout moments of the 2026/27 season so far as The Catch-Up Show brings together the very best programming content, showcasing unforgettable interviews, defining stories and fan favourites.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP16
programme.desc: Live. John Stones has experienced almost everything the game can offer; from the pressure of the biggest stage to the injuries and setbacks that have tested him along the way. After more than a decade at the heart of the Premier League, winning its biggest honours and helping redefine the role of a modern defender, he now takes his career in a new direction. As Stones begins a new life in Italy, we look back at the defining moments, relationships and challenges behind one of England's most decorated p.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP13
programme.desc: Live. As Manchester City embark on a new chapter, we celebrate the extraordinary legacy of Pep Guardiola, the visionary who transformed not only a football club, but the Premier League itself. From his formative years as a player and coach to redefining excellence in English football, we trace the journey that made him one of the greatest managers the game has ever seen. Through unprecedented success, relentless innovation and a lasting influence on generations to come, this is the story of the man wh.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP18
programme.desc: Live. From a celebrated playing career in Italy to becoming the man who transformed Manchester City into Premier League champions, Roberto Mancini's footballing life has been filled with triumph, drama and unforgettable characters. PL Stories explores his fiery relationship with Mario Balotelli, 'that' extraordinary final-day victory over QPR, and the deep friendship he shared with the late Gianluca Vialli. Mancini's interview is brutally honest, highlighting the defining moments and extraordinary car.

programme.title: PL REWIND - EP20
programme.desc: Live. Manchester City v QPR on the final day of the 2011/12 season will forever be remembered as the most dramatic of finales to a Premier League season. Shaun Wright-Phillips and Joleon Lescott offer the perspective from both sides, with the final day drama at the Etihad set in the context of Manchester City's Run-In and their pursuit of a first Premier League Title.
